3693-4659-4908-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4365-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4365-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2438-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

277-2577-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2577-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-5075--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-5075--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-2452-3249-5268--56.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2452-3249-5268--56.description:
Activate Grimgrin using Utopia Vow's ability by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the Zombie card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

277-3129-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1669-3257-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3259-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3699-5223.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-5223.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3497-4659-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying at most {2} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

147-6747-7300.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
147-6747-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-3000-4289-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-4927-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

625-1355-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
625-1355-1978.description:
Cause Sanctum Weaver to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-5147-5220-6537.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

2228-6854.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
2228-6854.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1. The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Hapatra and Host of the Hereafter.
Resolve the Hapatra trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Repeat from step 2.
2228-6854.notes: You can alternatively start the combo with one creature that has toughness equal to 1 and another creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it. If you do, kill the creature with a -1/-1 counter on it to start the combo.

1143-1912-2366-4552-4893.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {0}, causing you to draw a card.
Dryad Arbor triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

772-2921-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
772-2921-6553.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1445-2366-3129-4826-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2366-3129-4826-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-4089-5326.notablePrerequisites: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-4089-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1049-4499-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least three times this game.
1049-4499-5231.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Jirina.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Human Soldiers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
If you've cast your commander from the command zone at least four times, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and mana.

1887-2397-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1887-2397-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

527-539-3932.notablePrerequisites: Hope Tender and Selvala do not have summoning sickness.
527-539-3932.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping Hope Tender and Selvala.
Repeat.

2034-3569-4577-4772.notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least three reprieve counters.
2034-3569-4577-4772.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pollenbright Druid, adding {C}{C}.
Pollenbright Druid dies, triggering Magnanimous Magistrate, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield, causing you to proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

849-1422-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Narfi, adding {S}.
Narfi dies, triggering Anax, creating two 1/1 Satyr creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Satyrs, adding {S}{S}.
Activate Narfi by paying {S}{S}{S}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1283-2701-2825-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2701-2825-4222.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dark Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {3}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.

1975-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Hargilde.
Hargilde does not have summoning sickness.
1975-3263-4222.description:
Activate Hargilde by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Freed from the Real's second activated ability by paying {1}, untapping Hargilde.
Repeat.

2060-2313-2854-4770.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2313-2854-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

132-1978-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
132-1978-4306.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color you have devotion to.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2493-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

802-914-2649-4615.manaNeeded: {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, plus commander tax if applicable, plus one additional red, white, or blue mana if opponents control exactly three artifacts and/or enchantments
802-914-2649-4615.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
802-914-2649-4615.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Quasiduplicate from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Dockside Extortionist and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Dockside Extortionist mutated creature.
The token Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Quasiduplicate from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Resolve a second trigger from step 8, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 8, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 8 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 7, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature token.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)
